originalInput.context: Synthetic facilitator rehearsal. Each fragment represents at most one cue. Cue order is required; missing cues remain visible.

cues.text: Welcome participants to the paper boat workshop and introduce the learning goal.
Demonstrate how to fold the paper into a small boat.
Let participants practice folding their own paper boats.
Ask participants to share feedback about the workshop.

records.text: Welcome everyone to our workshop. Today we will learn to make origami paper boats.
Watch my hands while I show you how to crease this sheet into a boat.
Now take your own sheet and try making the folds yourself.
Please share your feedback on this workshop and tell us how we can improve the session.

warning: Rehearsal worksheet only, not proof that a cue was spoken correctly or understood. Supplied text is manually segmented: at most one fragment per cue and one cue per fragment. Neural semantic similarity is not entailment or confidence; negation and repeated wording can mislink. Exact dynamic programming maximizes sum(cosine-floor) with optional skips and strict increasing cue positions; it may omit a semantically valid fragment to preserve order. Independent nearest-cue baseline uses the same approved fragments and original scores; its duplicates/reversals are pair counts, not accuracy. Holds remain in the audit and can conceal missing evidence. No audio transcription, sending or execution.
